idCitation.resTitle: Millcreek 3D buildings LOD1.2 (2023 lidar), planning estimate

dataIdInfo.idPurp: 21,561 Millcreek, Utah, buildings as flat-roofed 3D blocks (LOD1.2): County footprints raised to their median 2023 lidar roof height. Unvalidated planning estimate; not surveyed or field-verified.
dataIdInfo.idAbs:
Planning estimate. This layer is an unvalidated estimate derived from lidar by City of Millcreek GIS. It has not been surveyed, engineered or checked in the field. Use it for planning, screening and display, not for legal, engineering, property-boundary, permitting or code-compliance decisions.

What it shows

Every Salt Lake County building footprint in Millcreek, Utah, that has a lidar roof, as a simple 3D block (CityGML level of detail 1.2): the footprint's outline, from the ground to a flat top at the building's median roof height. 21,561 buildings. They show the city's massing in a web scene: building heights, the scale of streets and how buildings sit on the terrain. Roof shapes are not modelled.

Each block carries its footprint's County attributes and lidar roof-height statistics (see the data dictionary), so a pop-up can show its height. The same statistics, for all 22,042 footprints, are in the Millcreek buildings and canopy cover zones feature layer; the two join on SOURCE_OID.

Using it in a scene

Put the Millcreek bare-earth terrain elevation layer in the scene's Ground, above World Elevation. The blocks were built on that terrain, so they stand on it exactly. On Esri's World Elevation alone they can float or sink by up to about a metre (see Coordinates).

How it was made

  1. Heights. For each County footprint, the median of lidar roof elevation minus bare-earth terrain over its 0.5 m cells (roof where at least two of three independent classifications agree that a point is building). The same figures as HEIGHT_P50_M in the feature layer.
  2. Blocks. ArcGIS Pro's Extract LOD2 Buildings tool at LOD1.2, from a 0.5 m surface that is the lidar roof inside the roofs and the terrain elsewhere, with the County footprints. Each block runs from the ground around the footprint to the median roof. 21,562 footprints with a height went in; one sliver of 0.5 m2 (FP_ID 21952) gave no block.
  3. Packaged as a scene layer package in WGS84 and published.

Accuracy and checks

  • Of 14,229 footprints with lidar roof on at least 95% of their area, the block top is within 1 m of the median roof for all but 13. Of the 2,380 with less than 80% roof (LOW_ROOF_SUPPORT in HEIGHT_STATUS), 695 are more than 1 m off, mostly low. 718 blocks in all are more than 1 m from the median roof (TOP_MINUS_ROOF50).
  • Block bases sit a median 0.11 m below the lowest terrain under the footprint. Four sit 3.6 to 7.2 m above it (FP_ID 22003, 16604, 4881, 6917): fully roofed sites where the tool read the ground near roof level.
  • The hosted layer's own statistics give 21,561 buildings with FP_ID 1 to 22,042, exactly the source's.
  • Roof classification on one hand-labelled 1 km tile (a hard sample, not a citywide accuracy): 92.8% of roof parts found, 2.8% of non-roof parts called roof. No block height has been compared with a survey or plan set.

Limits

  • Heights are roof-minus-terrain estimates, not code-defined building heights. Pitched roofs are shown flat at their median height, so ridges are higher than the block and eaves lower.
  • One block per County footprint. Footprints that hold several buildings, or buildings split across footprints, are shown as the County drew them; buildings missing from the County layer or built since are absent.
  • Low-support footprints (LOW_ROOF_SUPPORT) often have a lower roof part missed by the lidar classification, so their blocks are too low or too high over part of the footprint.

Coordinates

Horizontal: WGS84, taken from NAD83(2011) with the transformation WGS_1984_(ITRF08)_To_NAD_1983_2011, the same as every layer in the Millcreek LiDAR 2023 set. Vertical: the layer is labelled EGM96 (EPSG 5773), but its heights are NAVD88 (Geoid18) metres, left as they were measured. The packaging tool assigned the label because the source carried no vertical system. In the Salt Lake Valley the two surfaces differ by well under a metre, so on Esri's World Elevation the blocks sit within about that of the ground; on the Millcreek bare-earth terrain they match exactly. Block elevations run from 1,294.1 m to 1,764.2 m.

Lidar source. The 2023 Salt Lake Valley QL1 lidar (USGS project UT_2023SaltLakeCo_C24, USGS 3D Elevation Program), flown on October 7, November 2 and November 4, 2023. Quality level 1 means at least 8 pulses per square metre and a vertical accuracy (RMSEz) of 10 cm or better on open, non-vegetated ground under the USGS specification; the vendor's own accuracy report for this project has not been reviewed for these products. The points were reclassified for these products (see "How it was made"); the products are gridded at 0.5 m.

Data dictionary (43 fields)

Field names are shown as stored (the scene layer has no aliases). Fields from SOURCE_ID to BuiltYear and GlobalID to Editor are Salt Lake County's, carried unchanged; FOOTPRINT_M2 to HEIGHT_STATUS are the lidar statistics (identical to the feature layer); FP_ID onward were added when the blocks were built. Values are for the 21,561 blocks.

Field Alias Type Units Description
OBJECTID OBJECTID OID Row number of the block in the package (9 to 21,569, with gaps where empty features were removed). Not a key; use SOURCE_OID or FP_ID.
SOURCE_ID SOURCE_ID String Salt Lake County's OBJECTID for the footprint, as text (same number as SOURCE_OID).
SOURCE_OID SOURCE_OID Integer Salt Lake County's OBJECTID for the footprint, as a number. Join key to the Millcreek buildings feature layer and to the County footprints.
ADDRESS ADDRESS String County address attribute; empty for almost every footprint in this snapshot.
CITY CITY String County city attribute (mostly MILLCREEK). Not used to select footprints.
COUNTY COUNTY String County attribute (SALT LAKE COUNTY).
PARCEL_ID PARCEL_ID String County parcel number recorded on the footprint; not checked against current parcels.
SOURCE SOURCE String County attribute; empty for every footprint in this snapshot.
BuildType BuildType String County free-text building type; mostly empty; values include Appartments [sic], Residential, Commercial, Government and numeric codes. Not documented by the County.
Carto Carto SmallInteger County attribute with values 1, 2 and 6 on a few footprints; meaning not documented by the County.
JURISDICTION JURISDICTION String County jurisdiction attribute (mostly Millcreek; some empty).
BLDGHEIGHT BLDGHEIGHT Double County height field; empty for every footprint. Not used: the block height comes from the lidar.
BuiltYear BuiltYear SmallInteger year County year built; present for only a handful of footprints.
GlobalID GlobalID String County editor-tracking global ID, carried unchanged (dropped from the feature layer).
CreationDate CreationDate Date County editor tracking: when the County created the footprint record.
Creator Creator String County editor tracking: the County account that created the record.
EditDate EditDate Date County editor tracking: when the County last edited the record.
Editor Editor String County editor tracking: the County account that last edited the record.
FOOTPRINT_M2 FOOTPRINT_M2 Double square metres True ground area of the whole footprint, computed in NAD83(2011) / UTM 12N.
AOI_PCT AOI_PCT Double percent Share of the footprint inside the Millcreek city limits, 0 to 100.
ROOF_COV_PCT ROOF_COV_PCT Double percent Roof support: share of the footprint's 0.5 m cells with a lidar roof and terrain. Under 80 sets LOW_ROOF_SUPPORT. A review indicator, not an accuracy.
ROOF_Z50_M ROOF_Z50_M Double metres, NAVD88 (Geoid18) Median lidar roof elevation over the footprint's roof cells.
GROUND_Z50_M GROUND_Z50_M Double metres, NAVD88 (Geoid18) Median bare-earth terrain elevation in the same cells (interpolated under the building).
HEIGHT_P50_M HEIGHT_P50_M Double metres Median roof minus terrain: the height the block is built to (0.80 to 37.06). Not a code-defined building height.
HEIGHT_P95_M HEIGHT_P95_M Double metres 95th percentile of roof minus terrain; close to the highest roof parts.
HEIGHT_MAX_M HEIGHT_MAX_M Double metres Highest single cell of roof minus terrain; can be a chimney, rooftop unit, branch or noise.
GRID_CELLS GRID_CELLS Integer cells of 0.25 m2 0.5 m cells whose centres fall inside the footprint's part within the city.
ROOF_CELLS ROOF_CELLS Integer cells of 0.25 m2 Of those, cells with both a lidar roof and terrain; the cells the statistics use.
NEG_H_CELLS NEG_H_CELLS Integer cells of 0.25 m2 Cells with roof below terrain (kept in the statistics).
PARTIAL_AOI PARTIAL_AOI Integer 1 if the footprint crosses the city limit, otherwise 0.
HEIGHT_STATUS HEIGHT_STATUS String Review flags separated by semicolons; see HEIGHT_STATUS flags below.
FP_ID FP_ID Integer The footprint's row number in the lidar building-heights table (1 to 22,042), used to join each block back to its statistics when the blocks were built. Unique per block.
ORIG_OID ORIG_OID Integer Written by Extract LOD2 Buildings; by its name and range, the row number of the footprint in the tool's input (1 to 21,562). Internal to the build; not the same as FP_ID. Do not use as a key.
RMSE RMSE Double metres (presumed) Written by Extract LOD2 Buildings; Esri's tool documentation does not define it. By its name and values a fit statistic of the block against the lidar height surface (median 1.04, range 0.02 to 19.43). Not reviewed; do not use as an accuracy.
MEAN_ERR MEAN_ERR Double metres (presumed) Written by Extract LOD2 Buildings; not defined in Esri's tool documentation. By its name and values a mean fit difference (median 0.66, range 0.01 to 13.74). Not reviewed; do not use as an accuracy.
PCT_HI_ERR PCT_HI_ERR Double fraction 0 to 1 Written by Extract LOD2 Buildings; not defined in Esri's tool documentation. A fraction from 0 to 1 (median 0.45; 262 blocks 0, 4 blocks 1), by its name the share of the surface with a high fit difference. Not reviewed.
LOD LOD Double Level of detail of the block: 1.2 for every block (flat roof at the building's median height).
MP_VOL MP_VOL Double cubic metres Volume of the block (0.06 to 264,766 m3); equals footprint area times block height (TOP_Z minus BASE_Z) to within 0.1% for 90% of blocks. Ground to median roof, not an interior volume.
BASE_Z BASE_Z Double metres, NAVD88 (Geoid18) Elevation of the block's base, its lowest point (1,294.10 to 1,750.30).
TOP_Z TOP_Z Double metres, NAVD88 (Geoid18) Elevation of the block's flat top, its highest point (1,295.55 to 1,764.18).
TERRAIN_MIN_Z TERRAIN_MIN_Z Double metres, NAVD88 (Geoid18) Lowest bare-earth terrain cell under the footprint (1,294.30 to 1,750.51).
TOP_MINUS_ROOF50 TOP_MINUS_ROOF50 Double metres TOP_Z minus ROOF_Z50_M: how far the block top is from the median lidar roof (median -0.05; -29.75 to +0.10). Large negatives are low-support footprints.
BASE_MINUS_TMIN BASE_MINUS_TMIN Double metres BASE_Z minus TERRAIN_MIN_Z: the block base against the lowest terrain under it (median -0.11; -10.91 to +7.17). Negative only hides wall below ground; four blocks are 3.6 to 7.2 m above.

HEIGHT_STATUS flags

Every block carries UNVALIDATED, plus any of: LOW_ROOF_SUPPORT (lidar roof on under 80% of the footprint's cells; a review flag, not an accuracy threshold), NEGATIVE_HEIGHT (at least one cell with roof below terrain, kept), PARTIAL_AOI (the footprint crosses the city limit; statistics use the part inside) and GEOMETRY_REPAIRED (the County polygon was invalid and was repaired). Footprints with no roof support have no block.

The Millcreek LiDAR 2023 set. Eight layers from the same lidar and the same processing: buildings and canopy cover zones (feature layer), 3D buildings (scene layer), bare-earth terrain (elevation layer), hillshade (tile layer), slope classes, 2 m contours, treetops and tree crowns (vector tile layers). They share one coordinate transformation and one terrain, so they can be stacked in one map or scene.

Questions or corrections: City of Millcreek GIS. The processing records (scripts, checks and run logs) are kept by City of Millcreek GIS.

These data are unvalidated planning estimates produced by City of Millcreek GIS from 2023 lidar. They are not surveyed, engineered or field-verified, and must not be used to determine property boundaries or ownership, building or site design, engineering, flood or drainage design, code compliance (including building height), or any legal or regulatory determination. They are provided as is, without warranty of accuracy, completeness or fitness for any purpose; check conditions on the ground before relying on them. Credit "City of Millcreek GIS; 2023 Salt Lake Valley QL1 lidar (USGS 3DEP)" when you use or show them.

Salt Lake County data. The building footprints and their County attributes come from Salt Lake County (Assessor and Surveyor). The County's own terms apply to them: the County states that its footprints are not field verified, are for general reference only, and are not intended to determine property ownership, final building and site design or jurisdictional boundaries, or to replace a certified topographical or boundary survey or any other legal document.

dataLineage.statement: County building footprints (Salt Lake County, downloaded 2026-10-19) extruded by ArcGIS Pro Extract LOD2 Buildings at LOD1.2 from a 0.5 m surface of consensus lidar roofs and bare-earth terrain from the 2023 Salt Lake Valley QL1 lidar, packaged as a scene layer package in WGS84 (WGS_1984_(ITRF08)_To_NAD_1983_2011); heights NAVD88 (Geoid18) metres, labelled EGM96. Lidar flown 2023-10-07 to 2023-11-04 (USGS project UT_2023SaltLakeCo_C24). Unvalidated planning estimate; not surveyed or field-verified.
